subject.title: fix(update): dev channel update builds from an unverified checkout at the git install path

question: Should package-to-dev conversion categorically refuse every pre-existing `OPENCLAW_GIT_DIR`, including empty and canonical OpenClaw checkouts, to avoid trusting any adopted Git state?
rationale: The fresh-only rule establishes a clear security boundary but deliberately removes a documented setup path and changes operator recovery behavior, so permanent acceptance requires explicit updater ownership.

options.title: Require fresh paths
options.body: Adopt unused-path-only package-to-dev conversion and retain the managed staging and replacement recovery design.

options.title: Design trusted provenance
options.body: Preserve checkout reuse only after defining durable provenance that covers effective Git configuration, refs, contents, and ownership.

options.title: Pause the contract change
options.body: Keep current conversion behavior until maintainers approve a different security and compatibility design.

recommendation.title: Require fresh paths
recommendation.body: Adopt unused-path-only package-to-dev conversion and retain the managed staging and replacement recovery design.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history places this person on the central updater orchestration and handoff path affected by this decision.
